title: South Dakota Codified Laws Chapter 49-34A - Gas and Electric Utilities Regulation
verified_how: fetched the Title index https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/49: CatchLine 'PUBLIC UTILITIES AND CARRIERS', chapter row '34A Gas And Electric Utilities Regulation' with no [Repealed] marker (siblings 49-04, 49-05, 49-08, 49-09, 49-41 and 49-41A do carry '[Repealed]'); then fetched https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/49-34A: Type 'Chapter', CatchLine 'GAS AND ELECTRIC UTILITIES REGULATION', Repealed false, sections 49-34A-1 to 49-34A-116. Currency: code effective date 2026-09-03.
notes: The Public Utilities Commission's rate, tariff and service-territory regulation of gas and electric utilities - the statutory basis for what a customer is charged. Charges pending rate litigation are ch. 49-11; telecommunications service is ch. 49-31. Much of the operative billing, deposit and disconnection detail is in PUC administrative rules (ARSD art. 20:10) rather than in the statute.
